title: Fun for Girls' Night
text: Fun for Girls' Night. These are fun little kits! I was a little confused with the description. I was thinking I would get 36 kits, but in reality there are 6. There are 36 total pieces - 6 per kit. My daughter is in college, so I thought she and her friends might get a kick out of these. I did keep one for myself. I appreciate that the items in the kits are name brand and familiar products.

👜 Efficiently packaged in a small 4” x 6” waterproof bag designed to fit into even the tiniest of clutches. Serves perfectly as a wedding day emergency kit for bride and bachelorette gifts!
👗 Strategically designed for bachelorette party favors, supplies, wedding favors, party favors adults, bridal showers, 21st birthday gifts, and just a simple girls’ night out!
❤️‍🔥 Everything you and your squad need for the morning after. Consider these hangover kit bags as your emergency survival kit for the day after. You're welcome.
